prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity restrained dark desktop personal portfolio comp, 1536 by 1024 landscape
Primary request: Design a subtle, non-marketing personal website for Colton Spurgin as a well-kept work index. The work should lead, while a plain biography gives enough human context. It must feel maintained and useful rather than branded.
Scene/backdrop: flat front-facing website screenshot on deep neutral black
Subject: Colton is a software developer, Air Force NCO, research assistant, and UWF senior studying artificial intelligence; he graduates December 2026
Style/medium: restrained studio index, tabular data, quiet sans-serif typography, small status words, thin separators, discreet hover wash; no visible concept styling
Composition/framing: a modest header shows Colton Spurgin and links Work, Background, Notes, Contact. Below, a two-column opening uses only one quarter of the viewport height. Left: “I’m Colton, a software developer and UWF senior studying AI.” Right: “I’m also an Air Force NCO and research assistant. I graduate in December 2026 and plan to pursue a master’s degree.” Then a large plain index dominates the viewport with column labels Project, What it is, Tools, Status, Link. Rows: Bork — dog-themed social app — TypeScript · Next.js — active — source; VeLLM — client for self-hosted Ollama models — Tauri · Rust — in progress — source; Traveling Salesman benchmarks — exact and heuristic comparison framework — C++ — complete — report; Home lab — infrastructure automation — Ansible · Proxmox — ongoing — private. Beneath it begin Background rows for Lead software developer intern, Air Force NCO, Research assistant, and UWF · AI specialization. Use one muted green row wash on the hovered project as the only visual moment.
Color palette: flat black #0a0b0c, chalk #ecebe7, cool gray #73777a, muted green #6d8174
Materials/textures: flat screen color, one-pixel dividers, tabular numerals, no physical texture
Text (verbatim): “Colton Spurgin”; “Work”; “Background”; “Notes”; “Contact”; “I’m Colton, a software developer and UWF senior studying AI.”; “I’m also an Air Force NCO and research assistant. I graduate in December 2026 and plan to pursue a master’s degree.”; “Project”; “What it is”; “Tools”; “Status”; “Link”; “Bork”; “dog-themed social app”; “TypeScript · Next.js”; “active”; “source”; “VeLLM”; “client for self-hosted Ollama models”; “Tauri · Rust”; “in progress”; “Traveling Salesman benchmarks”; “exact and heuristic comparison framework”; “C++”; “complete”; “report”; “Home lab”; “infrastructure automation”; “Ansible · Proxmox”; “ongoing”; “private”; “Background”; “Lead software developer intern”; “Air Force NCO”; “Research assistant”; “UWF · AI specialization”
Constraints: ordinary language; normal-size headings; clearly usable dark website; high information density without clutter; no logo, portrait, slogan, invented employer names, metrics, awards, testimonials, or research specifics
Avoid: marketing landing page, oversized hero type, visual metaphor, themed interface, card grid, bento grid, neon, cyberpunk, terminal UI, cockpit, glassmorphism, gradients, decorative illustrations, rounded pills, heavy texture, 3D mockup, browser chrome, watermark
